news.title: Keystone reports 10% drop in Q2 revenue amid UK, US recruitment pressures
news.summary_en: Keystone Education Group has reported a 10% year-on-year decline in second-quarter revenue, with the company pointing to continued pressure on international student recruitment in the UK and US.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Breaking: UK Home Office suspends Buckinghamshire New University’s student sponsor licence
news.summary_en: The Home Office has suspended Buckinghamshire New University’s student sponsor licence, effective 30 September.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: UK TNE students near 700k as overseas provision overtakes onshore international enrolment
news.summary_en: UK universities are now educating more students overseas through transnational education (TNE) than they are hosting international students onshore.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: UEL launches US institution with Florida degree offer
news.summary_en: The London university will offer one-year bachelor’s completion routes and master’s degrees through its new US institution, with degree teaching starting in January 2027.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Finance and sales dominate first jobs at French business schools
news.summary_en: Deans Insight has mapped 347,414 first jobs across 23 Financial Times-ranked French business schools, highlighting significant differences in places where graduates begin their careers.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: If RAG ratings are out of date when published, what’s the point?
news.summary_en: The PIE’s Nicholas Cuthbert explores the timeline for the UK's new red-amber-green (RAG) rating system for sponsors, and finds it is more likely to mislead the public than provide assurances if it's not kept up to date.
news.author: Nicholas Cuthbert

news.title: Pakistani education consultant arrested over deposit withheld by UK uni
news.summary_en: A Pakistani education consultant has been arrested following allegations of fraud after a UK university's decision not to refund the deposit of a student who could not attend – opening up questions over who should bear ultimate financial responsibility.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Australia’s chancellors join university peak body as governance rules tighten
news.summary_en: Universities Australia will take on the chancellors’ council’s work and add three chancellor directors to its board ahead of new national standards.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: US overtakes UK in soft power as more world leaders educated in America
news.summary_en: The US has strengthened its position as the world’s leading source of educational soft power, with 66 serving world leaders having been educated there, compared with 60 educated in the UK.
news.author: Kim Martin
